theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U U' E : Set (Euclid P)) (T Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R RZ : IMRep U n) (RY : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen U → IsOpen U' → U' ⊆ U → IsCompact E → E ⊆ U' → R.Represents T → RZ.Represents Z → RY.Represents Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ U' → Z ω = T ω + Y (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω)) → RZ.measure E ≤ R.measure E + RY.measure E
